`CHANGELOG.md`:

```md
# Changelog

All notable changes to this project are documented in this file.

## [11.2.0] - 2026-11-20 - Full Dark Studio UI & Complete Control

### Added / Adicionado
- **Unified Zero-White Dark Studio UI Kit (14 Interactive Modals)**: Replaced all Win32 white `TEdit`, gray `TButton`, white `TComboBox`, `inputQuery`, and `showMessage` dialogs with custom flat dark controls, semantic accent buttons, focus-highlighted recessed inputs, custom dark dropdowns, and ESC-to-close support.
- **Central do Meu Elenco (`Squad Studio`, Tab 1)**: Live club roster viewer sorted by OVR with 4 filters (*All*, *Expiring <= 1 Yr*, *Injured*, *U23*), UTF-8 aligned columns, double-click to load straight into Studio, and quick squad actions.
- **Central Financeira (`Finances Hub`, Tab 1)**: Free exact Transfer Budget and Wage Budget editing (raise or lower to any amount, including `0`, `15M`, `500k`, `1.5B`) plus quick adjustments.
- **Granular Training Speed (`1x, 2x, 5x, 10x, 50x, Instant`) & All 6 Live Match Stamina Modes** (`Normal`, `Home 100%`, `Away 100%`, `Both 100%`, `Home Press`, `Away Press`) directly inside the Studio GUI.
- **7 COM AI Playing Styles + Player Name & Shirt Name**: Added all 7 COM AI styles to the Skills modal and UTF-8 Player Name / Shirt Name editing to the Profile modal.

### Fixed / Corrigido
- **Modal Header Visibility**: Parented modal title/subtitle labels inside the dark header panel so Win32 `TLabel` controls always paint on top of the header bar.
- **UTF-8 Monospaced Column Alignment**: Added `padRightUtf8()` across all tables (`Attributes`, `Position Lab`, `Scout Hub`, `Radar 30K`, `Squad Studio`) so Portuguese accented names align with exact column precision, plus modern `█` attribute progress bars.
- **Dashboard Hover Bleed-Through & Dropdown Overlap**: Blocked background hover highlights when any modal or external window is active/covering the cursor, and auto-closed open dark dropdowns when opening another.

---

## [11.1.0] - 2026-11-20 - Universal Capture & Full Studio Control

### Added / Adicionado
- **Universal 4-Point Player Capture (`Hook 1`)**: Automatically captures the currently highlighted player across **Game Plan**, **Transfer / Search Lists**, **Scout Observation Lists**, **Training Lists**, **Squad List**, and **Edit Player** (`INJECT_ptrPlayerListUI` at `RVA 0xF27462` + `INJECT_ptrPlayerGamePlan` at `RVA 0xDDCA5C`).
- **Complete Player Studio Tab (100% of Cheat Table in Visual Modals)**: Added full interactive dark modals for **All 25 Attributes (`40-99`)**, **22 Playing Styles & 41 Player Skills**, **Contracts, Exact Release Clause & Flags**, and **Bio, Condition, Stamina, Form Arrow, Breakthrough + Anti-Decline 30+ & JSON Backup/Restore**.
- **Bidirectional Isolated Secondary Position OVR**: Position Lab now gives full bidirectional control (`-1 OVR`, `+1 OVR`, exact `40-99` target input, `Match Primary OVR`, `Set as Primary`, `Grade A/B/C`) while minimizing cross-position bleed.

### Changed / Aprimorado
- **100% Pure Native Scout Observation Lists**: Inserting a player into **Scouts 1-3** or **Shortlist** now strictly writes the player's 64-bit handle to Master League RAM with zero unwanted side effects on release clause, affection, or transfer-listed flags. **Irresistible Deal** remains an explicit separate action.
- **Zero-Freeze Performance & Invisible Auto-Healing Hooks**: Replaced full-module AOB scans (`522 MB`) with `±4 KB` `aobscanregion` scans (`72 KB`, `< 5ms` arming), added silent automatic recovery of stale `0xE9` hook bytes left in RAM from unclean CE exits, added telemetry caching, and fixed re-entrant `C stack overflow` on reload.
- **Cleaner Studio Copy**: Shortened menu titles and subtitles across all 4 tabs and 32 cards (PT-BR & EN).

---

## [11.0.0] - 2026-11-19 - Ultimate Studio

### Added / Adicionado
- **4 Visual Dark Studio Modals (DPI-Aware, 100% Mouse-Driven)**:
  - **Radar 30K (Advanced Scout & Wonderkid Finder)**: Filter all 30,000 career players by Name/ID, Position, Min OVR, Max Age, Expiring Contract (≤ 1 Yr), Transfer Listed, or Free Agents, with 1-click *Load into Studio*, *+ Scout 1/2/3*, and *100% Deal*.
  - **Real-RAM Scout Observation Hub**: Live RAM viewer/manager for Master League **Scouts 1-3** (`30` slots each) and **Shortlist** (`100` slots), supporting add, load-from-scout, individual item removal, and clear.
  - **Visual Position Lab (Isolated OVR Engine)**: Interactive 13-position table with live isolated-attribute preview, **+1 Isolated OVR** (uses Konami's `23×13` weight differential to raise secondary position OVR with `+0` primary OVR drift!), **Match Primary OVR** (equalize OVR across two positions in 1 click), **Set as Primary Position**, *Set Grade A/B/C*, *Promote All B → A*, *All 13 to A*, and *Undo*.
  - **Visual Team Role Picker**: Interactive 22-role list + Level `1-3` selector + 5 one-click Level 3 presets (*Legend*, *Bandiera*, *Maestro*, *General*, *Superstar*).
- **10-Level Automatic Player Undo Stack**: Automatically snapshots the full `0x17C` player struct before every edit (`+1/-1 OVR`, `+1 Pos OVR`, `Aptitude`, `Team Role`, `Rejuvenate`, `Macros`, `Import JSON`), with a live **`Undo (N)`** button directly in the Studio Hero bar and CE tree.

---

## [10.2.0] - 2026-11-19

### Added / Adicionado
- **Position-Targeted +1 OVR Solver**: Boost +1 OVR in any of the 13 positions (including secondary positions) using Konami exact attribute weights for that position, while preserving player DNA. Automatically promotes position to Grade `A`.
- **Position Familiarity Editor (`C / B / A`)**: Edit grade for individual positions, promote all secondary `B → A` in 1 click, or maximize all 13 positions to `A`.
- **Team Role & Level Editor**: Set any of the 22 Team Roles (Legend, Bandiera, Maestro, General, Superstar, etc.) with Level 1-3 for Team Spirit, XP and merchandise bonuses.
- **Real-RAM 3 Scout Observation Lists & Shortlist (`fcn.140efe53f`)**: Directly writes the 64-bit player handle into Master League's real in-game Scout 1 (`+0x01676054`, 30 slots), Scout 2 (`+0x01676144`, 30 slots), Scout 3 (`+0x01676234`, 30 slots), and Shortlist (`+0x01675D34`, 100 slots), with live RAM occupancy preview, duplicate prevention, and real RAM clear (`0x0000FFFF`), plus Transfer/Loan listing, 100% Affection, recent-arrival unlock, and `€ 1,000` release clause override.
- **Position-Weighted Secondary OVR Solver**: When boosting `+1 OVR` in a secondary position, blends Konami's exact target-position weight column with the player's own DNA so attribute gains remain surgical and realistic without inflating irrelevant stats.
- **Irresistible Deal (1-Click)**: Transfer lists the player, sets minimal release fee, maxes affection to 100%, clears cooldown - guarantees 1st round proposal acceptance.

### Fixed / Corrigido
- **Scout Player Handle Offset**: Fixed `addPlayerToScoutList` to read the 64-bit player handle at `playerAddr + 0x2C`.
- **Win32 GDI Toast & Card Tag Polish**: Removed multi-line `\n` breaks and 4-byte emoji glyphs from single-line Canvas GUI footer toasts and card tag chips for crisp ClearType rendering across `100%`, `125%`, and `150%` DPI.
- **Version String Consistency**: Updated all internal references, GUI headers, dialogs, tests, and build outputs to `v10.2`.

---

## [10.1.0] - 2026-11-18

### Added / Adicionado
- **Bilingual Dual-Edition Release (`PT-BR` & `EN`)**: Full native **Português (PT-BR)** and **English (EN)** `.CT` editions compiled deterministically from source, plus a live **`[ PT | EN ]`** segmented switcher inside the Studio GUI header.
- **Konami Exact `OVR` Engine & Proportional DNA Solver**: Extracted the exact rating weight matrices (`23 × 13`) and non-linear lookup curve from `PES2021.exe` (`fcn.1414e7a50` + `fcn.141e640a0`), adding **`+1 OVR DNA`**, **`-1 OVR DNA`**, **`Target OVR (40-99)`**, double-clickable **`Current Overall`** row in Cheat Engine, **`Squad +1 OVR DNA`**, **`Rejuvenate (-2 Yrs) & Sync Market Value`**, and the **`13-Position & DNA X-Ray`** tactical advisor.
- **Zero-Click Auto-Arm Master Hooks**: Automatically activates all 6 Master Hooks (`900ms` settle delay) upon attaching to `PES2021.exe`.
- **Stateful Active Mode Badges (`● ATIVO` / `● ACTIVE`)**: Persistent toggle cards in the Studio GUI (*Training 10x / Instant / 1x*, *Freeze Clock*, *Home / Away 100% Stamina*) now glow with an active border and status chip, with click-to-toggle reset on Stamina cards.

### Changed / Aprimorado
- **Offscreen Double-Buffered `Canvas` Studio GUI (`940 × 636` logical `ClientWidth × ClientHeight`)**: Replaced nested LCL `TPanel`/`TLabel` controls with a custom offscreen-buffered `TBitmap.Canvas` renderer, eliminating titlebar/border clipping, text overflow, flicker, and vertical/horizontal spacing asymmetries across `100%`, `125%`, and `150%` DPI.
- **Streamlined 5-Section Cheat Table Tree**: Consolidated root sections from 7 to 5 clean categories mirroring the 4 Studio GUI tabs, with `[ ★ OPEN PRO STUDIO GUI ]` at Row #1 and instant Player OVR controls at the top of `Edit Player`.

---

## [10.0.0] - 2026-11-18

### Added / Adicionado
- Initial **v10.0 Pro Overhaul**: Dark Studio 4-tab GUI, Euro (`€`) human financial formatter/parser (`50M`, `500k`, `1.5B`), 64-slot Exact Release Clause Override (`Hook 2`), User-Only Sub-XP Multiplier (`Hook 3`), BAL 99 Focus Points unlock (`Hook 4`), Live RAM Club Decoder (`+0xADF4BC`), Global 30,000-Player Search, JSON Player Backup/Restore, FNV-1a crash-free Match Clock & Sider-safe Score/Stamina hooks (`Hook 5` & `Hook 6`).
```

# PES 2021 - Cheat Table v11.2 Ultimate Studio (PT-BR & EN)

![Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/Version-v11.2_Ultimate_Studio-38BDF8?style=for-the-badge)

![Sider Compatible](https://img.shields.io/badge/Sider_7.3_%2F_BMPES_16.0-100%25_Compatible-F59E0B?style=for-the-badge)
![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-8B5CF6?style=for-the-badge)

> **[Português (PT-BR)](#português-pt-br)** | **[English](#english)** | **[Build & Testes](#build--testes)**

---

## Português (PT-BR)

Cheat Table bilíngue (**PT-BR** e **EN**) para **eFootball PES 2021 (`v1.7.2.0`)**, feita via engenharia reversa x64 e compatível com **Sider 7.3+** e grandes patches (**BMPES 16.0**, **SmokePatch / Football Life**, **VirtuaRED**, **Dream Patch**).

### Como usar

1. Baixe a versão no seu idioma em [`dist/`](dist):
   - **PT-BR**: [`PES 2021 - v11.2 Ultimate Studio (PT-BR).CT`](dist/PES%202021%20-%20v11.2%20Ultimate%20Studio%20(PT-BR).CT)
   - **EN**: [`PES 2021 - v11.2 Ultimate Studio (EN).CT`](dist/PES%202021%20-%20v11.2%20Ultimate%20Studio%20(EN).CT)
2. Abra o **PES 2021** e abra o `.CT` no **Cheat Engine 7.2+ (64-bit)** (aceite executar o script Lua).
3. O anexo ao `PES2021.exe` e a ativação dos **6 Hooks Mestres** acontecem automaticamente (moeda padrão: `€`).
4. Clique em **`[ ★ ABRIR PAINEL STUDIO ]`** para abrir a interface gráfica (troca de idioma `PT | EN` e moeda `€ / R$ / $ / £` no topo).

### Funcionalidades

- **Laboratório de Posições (`+1 OVR Isolado` e `Igualar OVR`)**: usa a matriz real `23x13` da Konami (`fcn.141e640a0`) para subir o OVR em uma posição secundária isolando os atributos exclusivos dela, sem subir (ou subindo o mínimo possível) o OVR da posição principal. Inclui `Igualar OVR à Principal`, `Tornar Principal` e edição de Grau `A / B / C` (ou promover todas `B -> A`).
- **Overall Proporcional (`OVR DNA`)**: `+1 OVR`, `-1 OVR`, `OVR Alvo (40-99)`, `Elenco +1 OVR` e `Raio-X de 13 Posições`, preservando a proporção e o estilo de jogo do atleta.
- **Desfazer Automático (`Undo`)**: salva até 10 snapshots completos (`0x17C` bytes) por jogador antes de cada edição, com reversão em 1 clique.
- **Olheiros na RAM Real (`fcn.140efe53f`)**: gerencia diretamente na RAM da Master League os **3 Olheiros** (30 vagas cada) e a **Shortlist** (100 vagas), além de **Negociação Irrecusável** (lista de transferência, multa `€ 1.000`, afeição 100% e destravar chegada).
- **Team Roles e Longevidade**: seletor visual com todas as **22 funções de equipe** (nível 1-3) + 5 presets rápidos (*Lenda*, *Bandeira*, *Maestro*, *General*, *Superestrela*), **Auge (Breakthrough) + Anti-Declínio 30+** e **Rejuvenescer (-2 anos)**.
- **Finanças, Sub-XP, BAL e Partida ao Vivo**: valores formatados com entrada natural (`50M`, `500k`, `1.5B`), override de multa rescisória para até 64 atletas, multiplicador de treino (`2x` a `Instantâneo`) restrito ao seu clube/base/BAL, 99 Focus Points no BAL, pulo de minuto sem crash FNV-1a, congelar relógio, placar sincronizado e Stamina seletiva.

---

## English

Bilingual (**EN** & **PT-BR**) Cheat Table for **eFootball PES 2021 (`v1.7.2.0`)**, built via x64 reverse engineering with full compatibility for **Sider 7.3+** and major patches (**SmokePatch / Football Life**, **VirtuaRED**, **Dream Patch**, **BMPES 16.0**).

### Quick Start

1. Download your edition from [`dist/`](dist):
   - **EN**: [`PES 2021 - v11.2 Ultimate Studio (EN).CT`](dist/PES%202021%20-%20v11.2%20Ultimate%20Studio%20(EN).CT)
   - **PT-BR**: [`PES 2021 - v11.2 Ultimate Studio (PT-BR).CT`](dist/PES%202021%20-%20v11.2%20Ultimate%20Studio%20(PT-BR).CT)
2. Launch **PES 2021** and open the `.CT` file in **Cheat Engine 7.2+ (64-bit)** (click **Yes** to run the Lua script).
3. Auto-attaches to `PES2021.exe` and arms all **6 Master Hooks** automatically (default currency: `€`).
4. Click **`[ ★ OPEN PRO STUDIO GUI ]`** to launch the Studio Dashboard (`PT | EN` and `€ / R$ / $ / £` toggles in the header).

### Features

- **Position Lab (`+1 Isolated OVR` & `Match Primary OVR`)**: uses Konami's `23x13` weight matrix (`fcn.141e640a0`) to boost secondary position OVR via exclusive attributes with zero (or minimal) primary OVR drift. Includes `Match Primary OVR`, `Set as Primary`, and `A / B / C` mastery editing.
- **DNA-Preserving Overall (`OVR DNA`)**: `+1 OVR`, `-1 OVR`, `Target OVR (40-99)`, `Squad +1 OVR`, and `13-Position X-Ray` without breaking playing style proportions.
- **10-Level Auto `Undo`**: automatic full-struct (`0x17C`) snapshots per player before every edit, with 1-click revert.
- **Real-RAM Scout Hub (`fcn.140efe53f`)**: directly reads/writes Master League **Scouts 1-3** (30 slots each) and **Shortlist** (100 slots) in RAM, plus **Irresistible Deal** (Transfer Listed, `€ 1,000` clause, 100% affection, arrival unlock).
- **Team Roles & Longevity**: visual picker for all **22 Team Roles** (Level 1-3) + 5 quick presets (*Legend*, *Bandiera*, *Maestro*, *General*, *Superstar*), **Breakthrough + Anti-Decline 30+**, and **Rejuvenate (-2 yrs)**.
- **Finances, Sub-XP, BAL & Sider-Safe Match Control**: shorthand inputs (`50M`, `500k`, `1.5B`), 64-slot Exact Release Clause Override, user-only training multiplier (`2x` to `Instant`), 99 BAL Focus Points, FNV-1a crash-free exact minute jump, clock freeze, live score sync, and selective stamina.

---

```CT
alloc(newmem_rfee,$1000,INJECT_ReleaseFeeGetter)

label(loop_rfee)
label(next_rfee)
label(miss_rfee)
label(orig_rfee)
label(hit_rfee)
label(ret_rfee)

newmem_rfee:
  test rcx,rcx
  jz orig_rfee
  push r8
  push r9
  push rdx
  mov r8,[rcx]
  test r8,r8
  jz miss_rfee
  lea r9,[rfeeOverrideTable]
  xor edx,edx
loop_rfee:
  cmp dword ptr [r9+0C],1
  jne next_rfee
  cmp [r9],r8
  je hit_rfee
next_rfee:
  add r9,10
  inc edx
  cmp edx,40
  jb loop_rfee

miss_rfee:
  pop rdx
  pop r9
  pop r8
orig_rfee:
  movaps [rsp+40],xmm6
  jmp ret_rfee

hit_rfee:
  mov eax,[r9+08]
  pop rdx
  pop r9
  pop r8
  mov rbx,[rsp+70]
  add rsp,50
  pop rdi
  pop rsi
  pop rbp
  ret

INJECT_ReleaseFeeGetter:
  jmp newmem_rfee
ret_rfee:
registersymbol(INJECT_ReleaseFeeGetter)

  db 0F 29 74 24 40

label(loop_stam)
label(found_stam)
label(is_away_stam)

label(ret_stam)

  je orig_stam

  test rcx,rcx
  jz orig_stam
  xor edx,edx

  mov rax,rdx
  add rax,F3
  lea rax,[rax+rax*4]
  cmp [rcx+rax*8],rbx
  je found_stam
  inc edx
  cmp edx,16
  jb loop_stam
  jmp orig_stam

found_stam:
  mov eax,[cfgStaminaMode]
  cmp edx,0B
  jae is_away_stam

  cmp eax,1
  je give_100_stam
  cmp eax,3
  je give_100_stam
  cmp eax,4
  je give_100_stam
  cmp eax,5
  je drain_stam
  jmp orig_stam

is_away_stam:
  cmp eax,2
  je give_100_stam
  cmp eax,3
  je give_100_stam
  cmp eax,5
  je give_100_stam
  cmp eax,4
  je drain_stam
  jmp orig_stam

  mov rbx,[rsp+50]
  mov rdi,[rsp+58]
  mov eax,64
  add rsp,30
  pop rbp
  ret

drain_stam:
  mov rbx,[rsp+50]
  mov rdi,[rsp+58]
  mov eax,05
  add rsp,30
  pop rbp
  ret

orig_stam:
  imul eax,[rbp+10],64
  mov rbx,[rsp+50]
  jmp ret_stam

  jmp newmem_stam
  nop
  nop
  nop
  nop

-- Automatic 10-Level Player Undo Stack (stores full 0x17C byte snapshot per playerAddr)
PES10.undoStack = {}
PES10.UNDO_MAX_DEPTH = 10

function PES10.pushPlayerUndo(playerAddr, actionLabel)
  if not playerAddr or playerAddr &lt;= 0x10000 or not PES10.isAttached() then return false end
  local snap = readBytes(playerAddr, 0x17C, true)
  if not snap or #snap &lt; 0x17C then return false end
  local stack = PES10.undoStack[playerAddr]
  if not stack then stack = {}; PES10.undoStack[playerAddr] = stack end
  stack[#stack + 1] = {
    bytes = snap,
    label = tostring(actionLabel or PES10.T("Edição", "Edit")),
    time = os.date and os.date("%H:%M:%S") or "",
  }
  while #stack &gt; PES10.UNDO_MAX_DEPTH do
    table.remove(stack, 1)
  end
  return true
end

function PES10.canUndoPlayer(playerAddr)
  local stack = playerAddr and PES10.undoStack[playerAddr]
  return (stack ~= nil and #stack &gt; 0) and #stack or 0
end

function PES10.undoLastPlayerEdit(playerAddr)
  local p = playerAddr or PES10.getSelectedPlayerOrWarn()
  if not p or p == 0 then return false end
  local stack = PES10.undoStack[p]
  if not stack or #stack == 0 then
    PES10.toast(PES10.T("Nenhuma alteração recente para desfazer neste atleta.", "No recent edit to undo for this player."))
    return false
  end
  local entry = table.remove(stack)
  writeBytes(p, entry.bytes)
  PES10.syncAllDynamicPointers()
  local pName = readString(p + 0x38, 34, false) or PES10.T("Atleta", "Player")
  local ovr, regPos = PES10.calcPlayerOVR(p)
  PES10.toast(string.format(
    PES10.T("Desfeito (%s) em %s - restaurado para %d %s! (%d no histórico)", "Undid (%s) on %s - restored to %d %s! (%d left)"),
    entry.label, pName, ovr, PES10.posShort(regPos), #stack
  ))
  if PES10.dashboardState and PES10.dashboardState.render then
    PES10.dashboardState.render(true)
  end
  return true
end

function PES10.setLang(langCode)
  if langCode ~= "pt" and langCode ~= "en" then return end
  PES10.lang = langCode
  PES10.toast(PES10.T("Idioma alterado para Português (PT-BR).", "Language switched to English (EN)."))
  if PES10.dashboardState and PES10.dashboardState.render then
    PES10.dashboardState.render(true)
  end
end

function PES10.toggleLang()
  PES10.setLang((PES10.lang == "en") and "pt" or "en")
end

-- Shared state block layout ($1000 bytes allocated near PES2021.exe)
PES10.SYM_OFFSETS = {
  ptrCareer               = 0x000,
  ptrBudget               = 0x000,
  ptrPlayer               = 0x008,
  ptrMatchMgr             = 0x010,
  ptrMatchState           = 0x018,
  ptrMatchHud             = 0x020,
  ptrMatchCore            = 0x028,
  ptrPlayerTraining       = 0x030,
  ptrPlayerSquadBonus     = 0x038,
  ptrPlayerReleaseSlot    = 0x040,
  ptrPlayerGrowthDesc     = 0x048,
  ptrBALTrainingRec       = 0x050,
  cfgCurrency             = 0x070,
  cfgTrainingMultMode     = 0x074,
  cfgStaminaMode          = 0x078,
  cfgFreezeClock          = 0x07C,
  valProtectedMatchTicks  = 0x080,
  valFrozenTotalTicks     = 0x084,
  valComputedReleaseFee   = 0x088,
  valCustomReleaseFee     = 0x08C,
  cfgLockBALFocusPoints   = 0x090,
  valComputedOVR          = 0x094,
  rfeeOverrideTable       = 0x100, -- 64 slots * 16 bytes (0x100..0x4FF)
}

-- ============================================================================
-- SAFE MEMORY R/W &amp; OFFLINE GUARD (ZERO PASCAL/SEH EXCEPTIONS)
-- ============================================================================
function PES10.isAttached()
  local pid = getOpenedProcessID()
  if not pid or pid == 0 then return false end
  local base = getAddressSafe(PES10.PROCESS_NAME)
  return base ~= nil and base ~= 0
end

function PES10.safeRegisterSymbol(name, addr)
  if name and type(addr) == "number" and addr &gt; 0 then
    registerSymbol(name, addr, true)
  end
end

function PES10.symAddr(name)
  if not PES10.isAttached() or PES10.stateBase == 0 then return 0 end
  local off = PES10.SYM_OFFSETS[name]
  if not off then return 0 end
  return PES10.stateBase + off
end

function PES10.readU64(addr)
  if not addr or addr &lt;= 0x10000 or not PES10.isAttached() then return 0 end
  return readQword(addr) or 0
end

function PES10.readU32(addr)
  if not addr or addr &lt;= 0x10000 or not PES10.isAttached() then return 0 end
  local v = readInteger(addr)
  if not v then return 0 end
  if v &lt; 0 then v = v + 0x100000000 end
  return v
end

function PES10.readI32(addr)
  if not addr or addr &lt;= 0x10000 or not PES10.isAttached() then return 0 end
  local v = readInteger(addr)
  if not v then return 0 end
  if v &gt;= 0x80000000 then v = v - 0x100000000 end
  return v
end

function PES10.readU16(addr)
  if not addr or addr &lt;= 0x10000 or not PES10.isAttached() then return 0 end
  local v = readSmallInteger(addr)
  if not v then return 0 end
  if v &lt; 0 then v = v + 0x10000 end
  return v
end

function PES10.readU8(addr)
  if not addr or addr &lt;= 0x10000 or not PES10.isAttached() then return 0 end
  return readBytes(addr, 1, false) or 0
end

function PES10.setBitsInDword(addr, bitStart, bitLen, newVal)
  if not addr or addr &lt;= 0x10000 or not PES10.isAttached() then return end
  local mask = ((1 &lt;&lt; bitLen) - 1) &lt;&lt; bitStart
  local cur = PES10.readU32(addr)
  local updated = ((cur &amp; (~mask)) | ((newVal &lt;&lt; bitStart) &amp; mask)) &amp; 0xFFFFFFFF
  if updated &gt;= 0x80000000 then updated = updated - 0x100000000 end
  writeInteger(addr, updated)
end

function PES10.getBitsInDword(addr, bitStart, bitLen)
  local cur = PES10.readU32(addr)
  return (cur &gt;&gt; bitStart) &amp; ((1 &lt;&lt; bitLen) - 1)
end

function PES10.normalizeText(s)
  if not s then return "" end
  local map = {
    ["á"]="a", ["à"]="a", ["â"]="a", ["ã"]="a", ["ä"]="a",
    ["Á"]="a", ["À"]="a", ["Â"]="a", ["Ã"]="a", ["Ä"]="a",
    ["é"]="e", ["è"]="e", ["ê"]="e", ["ë"]="e",
    ["É"]="e", ["È"]="e", ["Ê"]="e", ["Ë"]="e",
    ["í"]="i", ["ì"]="i", ["î"]="i", ["ï"]="i",
    ["Í"]="i", ["Ì"]="i", ["Î"]="i", ["Ï"]="i",
    ["ó"]="o", ["ò"]="o", ["ô"]="o", ["õ"]="o", ["ö"]="o",
    ["Ó"]="o", ["Ò"]="o", ["Ô"]="o", ["Õ"]="o", ["Ö"]="o",
    ["ú"]="u", ["ù"]="u", ["û"]="u", ["ü"]="u",
    ["Ú"]="u", ["Ù"]="u", ["Û"]="u", ["Ü"]="u",
    ["ç"]="c", ["Ç"]="c", ["ñ"]="n", ["Ñ"]="n",
  }
  local out = tostring(s)
  for k, v in pairs(map) do out = out:gsub(k, v) end
  return out:lower()
end

function PES10.toast(msg)
  PES10.lastToastMsg = "✓ " .. tostring(msg)
end

PES10.HOOK_IDS_BY_NUM = {}

-- Exact v1.7.2.0 hook RVAs + original bytes for automatic recovery if a previous CE session closed without disarming
PES10.HOOK_ORIG_BYTES = {
  [1] = {
    { rva = 0xC6ED40, checkOff = -19, checkByte = 0xCB, orig = {0x0F,0x10,0x02,0x0F,0x11,0x01} },
    { rva = 0x8E24D7, checkOff = -7,  checkByte = 0x48, orig = {0x48,0x8B,0x40,0x2C,0x48,0x89,0x02} },
    { rva = 0xDDCA5C, checkOff = 7,   checkByte = 0x89, orig = {0x0F,0xB6,0x80,0x50,0x01,0x00,0x00} },
    { rva = 0xF27462, checkOff = 7,   checkByte = 0x89, orig = {0x0F,0xB6,0x80,0x50,0x01,0x00,0x00} },
  },
  [2] = { { rva = 0x156BE0C, checkOff = 5,  checkByte = 0x48, orig = {0x0F,0x29,0x74,0x24,0x40} } },
  [3] = { { rva = 0x12E14A0, checkOff = 6,  checkByte = 0x0F, orig = {0x45,0x8B,0xC8,0x83,0xFA,0x6C} } },
  [4] = { { rva = 0xBBFE79,  checkOff = -8, checkByte = 0x0F, orig = {0x15}, staleByte = 0x7F } },
  [5] = {
    { rva = 0x20F9FD6, checkOff = 7, checkByte = 0x88, orig = {0x49,0x8B,0xF8,0x44,0x0F,0xB6,0xE2} },
    { rva = 0xA3C787,  checkOff = 8, checkByte = 0xF3, orig = {0x8B,0x44,0x24,0x40,0x89,0x44,0x24,0x40} },
  },
  [6] = { { rva = 0xA58EAC, checkOff = -2, checkByte = 0x00, orig = {0x6B,0x45,0x10,0x64,0x48,0x8B,0x5C,0x24,0x50}, anyNeighbor = true } },
}

function PES10.restoreStaleHookBytes(hookNum)
  local list = PES10.HOOK_ORIG_BYTES[hookNum]
  if not list or not PES10.isAttached() then return end
  local base = getAddressSafe(PES10.PROCESS_NAME)
  if not base or base == 0 then return end
  for _, h in ipairs(list) do
    local addr = base + h.rva
    local b0 = PES10.readU8(addr)
    local isStale = h.staleByte and (b0 == h.staleByte) or (b0 == 0xE9)
    if isStale then
      local okNeighbor = h.anyNeighbor or (PES10.readU8(addr + h.checkOff) == h.checkByte)
      if okNeighbor then
        pcall(function() writeBytes(addr, h.orig) end)
      end
    end
  end
end

function PES10.ensureHookActive(hookNum)
  if not PES10.isAttached() or PES10.stateBase == 0 then return end
  local id = PES10.HOOK_IDS_BY_NUM and PES10.HOOK_IDS_BY_NUM[hookNum]
  if not id then return end
  local al = getAddressList()
  if not al then return end
  local mr = al.getMemoryRecordByID(id)
  if mr and not mr.Active then
    PES10.restoreStaleHookBytes(hookNum)
    pcall(function() mr.Active = true end)
  end
end

function PES10.activateAllHooks(silent)
  if not PES10.isAttached() then
    if not silent then
      PES10.toast(PES10.T("Abra o PES2021.exe primeiro!", "Open PES2021.exe first!"))
    end
    return 0
  end
  PES10.initProcessState()
  if PES10.stateBase == 0 then return 0 end
  local al = getAddressList()
  if not al then return 0 end
  local okCount = 0
  for num = 1, 6 do
    local id = PES10.HOOK_IDS_BY_NUM[num]
    local mr = id and al.getMemoryRecordByID(id) or nil
    if mr then
      if not mr.Active then
        PES10.restoreStaleHookBytes(num)
        pcall(function() mr.Active = true end)
      end
      if mr.Active then okCount = okCount + 1 end
    end
  end
  if not silent then
    PES10.toast(string.format(
      PES10.T("Motor interno conectado (%d / 6 ativos).", "Internal engine connected (%d / 6 active)."),
      okCount
    ))
  end
  return okCount
end

function PES10.scheduleAutoArmHooks()
  if not PES10.autoArmHooks or not PES10.isAttached() then return end
  local pid = getOpenedProcessID()
  if not pid or pid == 0 or PES10.autoArmedPid == pid then return end
  PES10.autoArmedPid = pid
  local t = createTimer(MainForm, true)
  t.Interval = 900
  t.OnTimer = function(tmr)
    tmr.destroy()
    if PES10.isAttached() and getOpenedProcessID() == pid then
      PES10.activateAllHooks(true)
    end
  end
end

-- ============================================================================
-- HUMAN MONEY FORMATTER (€ 125.500.000) &amp; PARSER (50M, 500k, 1.5B)
-- ============================================================================
function PES10.getCurrentCurrency()
  local cAddr = PES10.symAddr("cfgCurrency")
  if cAddr ~= 0 then
    local idx = PES10.readU32(cAddr)
    if PES10.CURRENCIES[idx] then
      PES10.currencyIndex = idx
    end
  end
  return PES10.CURRENCIES[PES10.currencyIndex] or PES10.CURRENCIES[0]
end

function PES10.setCurrency(idx)
  if not PES10.CURRENCIES[idx] then return end
  PES10.currencyIndex = idx
  local cAddr = PES10.symAddr("cfgCurrency")
  if cAddr ~= 0 then
    writeInteger(cAddr, idx)
  end
  PES10.toast(string.format(
    PES10.T("Moeda alterada para %s (%s)", "Currency changed to %s (%s)"),
    PES10.CURRENCIES[idx].symbol, PES10.CURRENCIES[idx].code
  ))
end

function PES10.formatThousands(n, sep)
  sep = sep or "."
  local neg = n &lt; 0
  local s = string.format("%.0f", math.floor(math.abs(n) + 0.5))
  local out = s:reverse():gsub("(%d%d%d)", "%1" .. sep):reverse()
  if out:sub(1, 1) == sep then out = out:sub(2) end
  return (neg and "-" or "") .. out
end

function PES10.formatMoneyFromRaw(rawVal)
  local c = PES10.getCurrentCurrency()
  if rawVal == nil then return c.symbol .. " 0" end
  local signed = tonumber(rawVal)
  if not signed then return tostring(rawVal) end
  if signed &gt;= 0x80000000 then signed = signed - 0x100000000 end
  local realMoney = signed * 100
  return string.format("%s %s", c.symbol, PES10.formatThousands(realMoney, c.sep))
end

function PES10.parseHumanMoneyToRaw(inputStr)
  if not inputStr then return nil end
  local s = tostring(inputStr):upper()
  s = s:gsub("R%$", ""):gsub("[€%$£%s]", "")
  if s == "" then return nil end

  local mult = 1
  if s:sub(-1) == "B" then
    mult = 1000000000; s = s:sub(1, -2)
  elseif s:sub(-1) == "M" then
    mult = 1000000; s = s:sub(1, -2)
  elseif s:sub(-1) == "K" then
    mult = 1000; s = s:sub(1, -2)
  end

  if mult &gt; 1 then
    s = s:gsub(",", ".")
  else
    s = s:gsub("[.,]", "")
  end

  local val = tonumber(s)
  if not val then return nil end
  local raw = math.floor((val * mult + 0.5) / 100)
  if raw &gt; 2147483647 then raw = 2147483647 end
  if raw &lt; -2147483648 then raw = -2147483648 end
  return raw
end

-- ============================================================================
-- LIVE CLUB / NATIONAL TEAM RAM DECODER (+0xADF4BC, STRIDE 0x690)
-- ============================================================================
function PES10.decodeClubHandle(rawU32)
  local v = tonumber(rawU32)
  if not v then return 0, 0, PES10.T("Desconhecido", "Unknown") end
  if v &lt; 0 then v = v + 0x100000000 end
  if v == 0xFFFFFFFF or v == 0 then
    return 0, 0, PES10.T("Sem Clube / Livre", "Free Agent")
  end
  local slot = v % 16384
  local teamId = math.floor(v / 16384)

  local career = PES10.readU64(PES10.symAddr("ptrCareer"))
  if career ~= 0 and slot &lt; 1200 then
    local clubEntry = career + 0xADF4BC + (slot * 0x690)
    local entryHandle = PES10.readU32(clubEntry)
    if entryHandle == v or (entryHandle % 16384) == slot then
      local liveName = readString(clubEntry + 0x04, 64, false)
      local abbr = readString(clubEntry + 0x4A, 6, false)
      if liveName and liveName ~= "" then
        if abbr and abbr ~= "" then
          return teamId, slot, string.format("%s [%s] (ID %d)", liveName, abbr, teamId)
        end
        return teamId, slot, string.format("%s (ID %d)", liveName, teamId)
      end
    end
  end

  local fallback = PES10.BMPES_TEAMS[teamId]
  if fallback then
    return teamId, slot, string.format("%s (ID %d)", fallback, teamId)
  end
  return teamId, slot, string.format(PES10.T("Time ID #%d (Slot %d)", "Team ID #%d (Slot %d)"), teamId, slot)
end

PES10._clubCacheKey = ""
PES10._clubCacheName = ""

function PES10.getCareerModeAndClubInfo()
  local career = PES10.readU64(PES10.symAddr("ptrCareer"))
  if career == 0 then
    PES10._clubCacheKey = ""
    return PES10.T("Menu / Exibição", "Menu / Exhibition"), "", 0
  end
  local balHandle = PES10.readU64(career + 0x01819540)
  local isBAL = (math.floor(balHandle / 0x100000000) ~= 0)
  if isBAL then
    return PES10.T("Rumo ao Estrelato (BAL)", "Become a Legend (BAL)"), "", career
  end
  local h0 = PES10.readU64(career + 0x016EE854)
  local cacheKey = tostring(career) .. ":" .. tostring(h0)
  if PES10._clubCacheKey == cacheKey then
    return "Master League", PES10._clubCacheName, career
  end
  local clubName = ""
  if math.floor(h0 / 0x100000000) ~= 0 then
    local lowSlot = h0 % 0x100000000
    local count = PES10.readU32(career + 0x00D0BCE8)
    if count &gt; 30001 then count = 30000 end
    if lowSlot &lt; count then
      local cand = career + (lowSlot * 0x17C)
      if PES10.readU64(cand + 0x2C) == h0 then
        local _, _, cname = PES10.decodeClubHandle(PES10.readU32(cand + 0x12C))
        clubName = cname
      end
    end
    if clubName == "" then
      for i = 0, math.min(count - 1, 4000) do
        local p = career + (i * 0x17C)
        if PES10.readU64(p + 0x2C) == h0 then
          local _, _, cname = PES10.decodeClubHandle(PES10.readU32(p + 0x12C))
          clubName = cname
          break
        end
      end
    end
  end
  PES10._clubCacheKey = cacheKey
  PES10._clubCacheName = clubName
  return "Master League", clubName, career
end

-- ============================================================================
-- pes10State INITIALIZATION &amp; RIP-RELATIVE SINGLETON DISCOVERY
-- ============================================================================
function PES10.scanUniqueModuleAOB(aobStr)
  local base = getAddressSafe(PES10.PROCESS_NAME)
  if not base or base == 0 then return 0 end
  local ms = createMemScan()
  ms.firstScan(
    soExactValue, vtByteArray, rtRounded,
    aobStr, "",
    base + 0x1000, base + 0x2540000,
    "", fsmNotAligned, "", true, false, false, false
  )
  ms.waitTillDone()
  local fl = createFoundList(ms)
  fl.initialize()
  local addr = 0
  if fl.Count &gt;= 1 and fl.Address[0] then
    local s = tostring(fl.Address[0]):gsub("^0[xX]", "")
    addr = tonumber(s, 16) or getAddressSafe(fl.Address[0]) or 0
  end
  fl.destroy()
  ms.destroy()
  return addr
end

function PES10.initProcessState()
  if PES10.isInitializing then return false end
  if not PES10.isAttached() then return false end
  local pid = getOpenedProcessID()
  if PES10.attachedPid == pid and PES10.stateBase ~= 0 then
    return true
  end

  PES10.isInitializing = true
  local okRun, resRun = pcall(function()
    local exeBase = getAddressSafe(PES10.PROCESS_NAME)
    if not exeBase or exeBase == 0 then return false end
    if PES10.PROCESS_NAME ~= "PES2021.exe" then
      PES10.safeRegisterSymbol("PES2021.exe", exeBase)
    end

    local existing = getAddressSafe("pes10State")
    if existing and existing &gt; 0 then
      PES10.stateBase = existing
    else
      local mem = allocateMemory(0x1000, exeBase)
      if not mem or mem == 0 then mem = allocateMemory(0x1000) end
      if not mem or mem == 0 then return false end
      local zeros = {}
      for i = 1, 0x1000 do zeros[i] = 0 end
      writeBytes(mem, zeros)
      PES10.safeRegisterSymbol("pes10State", mem)
      PES10.stateBase = mem
    end

    for sym, off in pairs(PES10.SYM_OFFSETS) do
      PES10.safeRegisterSymbol(sym, PES10.stateBase + off)
    end
    writeInteger(PES10.stateBase + PES10.SYM_OFFSETS.cfgCurrency, PES10.currencyIndex or 0)

    -- Fast-path for standard PES2021.exe v1.7.2.0 (avoids blocking ms.waitTillDone() on main UI thread!)
    local fastCareer = exeBase + 0x3714240
    local fastMatch  = exeBase + 0x3702208
    if PES10.readU64(fastCareer) &gt; 0x10000 then
      PES10.addrCareerOwner = fastCareer
      PES10.safeRegisterSymbol("addrCareerOwner", PES10.addrCareerOwner)
      PES10.addrMatchMgr = fastMatch
      PES10.safeRegisterSymbol("addrMatchMgr", PES10.addrMatchMgr)
    else
      local callSite = PES10.scanUniqueModuleAOB("E8 ?? ?? ?? ?? 48 8B 48 48 48 8D 81 E0 CB 6E 01")
      if callSite ~= 0 then
        local relCall = PES10.readI32(callSite + 1)
        local fnGetter = callSite + 5 + relCall
        if PES10.readU8(fnGetter) == 0x48 and PES10.readU8(fnGetter + 1) == 0x8B and PES10.readU8(fnGetter + 2) == 0x05 then
          local disp = PES10.readI32(fnGetter + 3)
          PES10.addrCareerOwner = fnGetter + 7 + disp
          PES10.safeRegisterSymbol("addrCareerOwner", PES10.addrCareerOwner)
        end
      end
      if PES10.addrCareerOwner == 0 then
        PES10.addrCareerOwner = fastCareer
        PES10.safeRegisterSymbol("addrCareerOwner", PES10.addrCareerOwner)
      end

      local matchSite = PES10.scanUniqueModuleAOB("48 8B 05 ?? ?? ?? ?? 4C 8B E2 45 33 FF 48 8B B0 70 02 00 00")
      if matchSite ~= 0 then
        local disp = PES10.readI32(matchSite + 3)
        PES10.addrMatchMgr = matchSite + 7 + disp
        PES10.safeRegisterSymbol("addrMatchMgr", PES10.addrMatchMgr)
      else
        PES10.addrMatchMgr = fastMatch
        PES10.safeRegisterSymbol("addrMatchMgr", PES10.addrMatchMgr)
      end
    end

    PES10.attachedPid = pid
    PES10.syncAllDynamicPointers()
    PES10.scheduleAutoArmHooks()
    return true
  end)
  PES10.isInitializing = false
  return okRun and resRun or false
end

-- ============================================================================
-- REAL-TIME DYNAMIC POINTER SYNC &amp; KONAMI RELEASE FEE FORMULA
-- ============================================================================
function PES10.findRecordByHandle64(tableBase, count, stride, targetHandle)
  if tableBase == 0 or targetHandle == 0 then return 0 end
  local targetHigh = math.floor(targetHandle / 0x100000000)
  if targetHigh == 0 then return 0 end
  for i = 0, count - 1 do
    local slotAddr = tableBase + (i * stride)
    local h = PES10.readU64(slotAddr)
    if h ~= 0 then
      if h == targetHandle or math.floor(h / 0x100000000) == targetHigh then
        return slotAddr
      end
    end
  end
  return 0
end

function PES10.estimateReleaseFeeRaw(career, playerAddr, pHandle)
  if playerAddr == 0 then return 0 end
  local hasRfee = ((PES10.readU32(playerAddr + 0x144) &gt;&gt; 30) &amp; 1) == 1
  if PES10.stateBase ~= 0 and pHandle ~= 0 then
    local tbl = PES10.stateBase + PES10.SYM_OFFSETS.rfeeOverrideTable
    for i = 0, 63 do
      local entry = tbl + i * 16
      if PES10.readU32(entry + 0x0C) == 1 and PES10.readU64(entry) == pHandle then
        return PES10.readI32(entry + 0x08)
      end
    end
  end
  if not hasRfee then return 0 end
  local mkt = PES10.readI32(playerAddr + 0x174)
  if mkt &lt;= 0 then return 0 end

  -- Decompiled from Konami fcn.14156BE00 + fcn.14156BF80
  local age = PES10.readU8(playerAddr + 0x1C) &amp; 0x3F
  local affection = PES10.getBitsInDword(playerAddr + 0x13C, 18, 7)
  local f12 = (affection * 0.7) - 50.0
  local i4 = math.floor((50 - age) - 20 + f12)
  if i4 &gt; 100 then i4 = 100 elseif i4 &lt; -50 then i4 = -50 end
  local f8 = (i4 / 100.0) + 1.0
  return math.max(1, math.floor(mkt * f8 + 0.5))
end

PES10._lastBalKey = ""
PES10._lastPlayerKey = ""

function PES10.syncAllDynamicPointers()
  if not PES10.isAttached() or PES10.stateBase == 0 then return end
  local sb = PES10.stateBase

  local career = 0
  if PES10.addrCareerOwner ~= 0 then
    local owner = PES10.readU64(PES10.addrCareerOwner)
    if owner ~= 0 then career = PES10.readU64(owner + 0x48) end
  end
  writeQword(sb + PES10.SYM_OFFSETS.ptrCareer, career)

  local matchMgr, matchState = 0, 0
  if PES10.addrMatchMgr ~= 0 then
    matchMgr = PES10.readU64(PES10.addrMatchMgr)
    if matchMgr ~= 0 then matchState = PES10.readU64(matchMgr + 0x270) end
  end
  writeQword(sb + PES10.SYM_OFFSETS.ptrMatchMgr, matchMgr)
  writeQword(sb + PES10.SYM_OFFSETS.ptrMatchState, matchState)

  local mHud = PES10.readU64(sb + PES10.SYM_OFFSETS.ptrMatchHud)
  if mHud ~= 0 then
    writeQword(sb + PES10.SYM_OFFSETS.ptrMatchCore, PES10.readU64(mHud + 0x38))
  end

  if PES10.readU32(sb + PES10.SYM_OFFSETS.cfgTrainingMultMode) &gt; 0 then PES10.ensureHookActive(3) end
  if PES10.readU32(sb + PES10.SYM_OFFSETS.cfgStaminaMode) &gt; 0 then PES10.ensureHookActive(6) end
  if PES10.readU32(sb + PES10.SYM_OFFSETS.cfgFreezeClock) &gt; 0 then PES10.ensureHookActive(5) end

  if career ~= 0 then
    if PES10.readU32(sb + PES10.SYM_OFFSETS.cfgLockBALFocusPoints) == 1 then
      PES10.ensureHookActive(4)
      writeBytes(career + 0x016ECBEA, 99)
    elseif PES10.readU8(career + 0x016ECBEA) &gt; 21 then
      PES10.ensureHookActive(4)
    end
    local balHandle = PES10.readU64(career + 0x01819540)
    local balKey = tostring(career) .. ":" .. tostring(balHandle)
    if PES10._lastBalKey ~= balKey then
      PES10._lastBalKey = balKey
      local balRec = (math.floor(balHandle / 0x100000000) ~= 0) and PES10.findRecordByHandle64(career + 0x016BF710, 82, 0x170, balHandle) or 0
      writeQword(sb + PES10.SYM_OFFSETS.ptrBALTrainingRec, balRec)
    end
  else
    PES10._lastBalKey = ""
    writeQword(sb + PES10.SYM_OFFSETS.ptrBALTrainingRec, 0)
  end

  local pAddr = PES10.readU64(sb + PES10.SYM_OFFSETS.ptrPlayer)
  if pAddr ~= 0 and career ~= 0 then
    local pHandle = PES10.readU64(pAddr + 0x2C)
    local pKey = tostring(career) .. ":" .. tostring(pAddr) .. ":" .. tostring(pHandle)
    if PES10._lastPlayerKey ~= pKey then
      PES10._lastPlayerKey = pKey
      local pId = PES10.readU32(pAddr + 0x30)
      local lowHandle = PES10.readU32(pAddr + 0x2C)

      local trnSlot = PES10.findRecordByHandle64(career + 0x016BF710, 82, 0x170, pHandle)
      local bonusSlot = PES10.findRecordByHandle64(career + 0x016EE854, 40, 0x34, pHandle)
      local rfeeSlot = PES10.findRecordByHandle64(career + 0x01674D98, 40, 0x18, pHandle)
      local growthAddr = 0
      if (lowHandle % 0x10000) &lt; 0x61A9 then
        growthAddr = career + 0x01676324 + ((lowHandle % 0x10000) * 4)
      elseif (pId % 0x10000) &lt; 0x61A9 then
        growthAddr = career + 0x01676324 + ((pId % 0x10000) * 4)
      end

      writeQword(sb + PES10.SYM_OFFSETS.ptrPlayerTraining, trnSlot)
      writeQword(sb + PES10.SYM_OFFSETS.ptrPlayerSquadBonus, bonusSlot)
      writeQword(sb + PES10.SYM_OFFSETS.ptrPlayerReleaseSlot, rfeeSlot)
      writeQword(sb + PES10.SYM_OFFSETS.ptrPlayerGrowthDesc, growthAddr)
    end
    writeInteger(sb + PES10.SYM_OFFSETS.valComputedReleaseFee, PES10.estimateReleaseFeeRaw(career, pAddr, pHandle))
    writeInteger(sb + PES10.SYM_OFFSETS.valComputedOVR, PES10.calcPlayerOVR(pAddr))
  else
    PES10._lastPlayerKey = ""
    writeQword(sb + PES10.SYM_OFFSETS.ptrPlayerTraining, 0)
    writeQword(sb + PES10.SYM_OFFSETS.ptrPlayerSquadBonus, 0)
    writeQword(sb + PES10.SYM_OFFSETS.ptrPlayerReleaseSlot, 0)
    writeQword(sb + PES10.SYM_OFFSETS.ptrPlayerGrowthDesc, 0)
    writeInteger(sb + PES10.SYM_OFFSETS.valComputedOVR, 0)
  end
end
```
